contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #067: The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six.

Audit the implication from the actual pseudoindex-five minimal universal family of a smooth complex Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle and Picard number one to 3S^2-20SD+32D^2=0, without certifying the full sixfold theorem.

definitions.F: general connected evaluation fibre of complex dimension three
definitions.L: tangent-map polarization with c1(L)=ell restricted to F
definitions.r,s,t: elementary symmetric functions of the three roots of T_e shifted by h

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 067 (The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six.; papers: The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.
Independently verify the pseudoindex-five numerical implication, or refute a precise asserted intermediate statement with a premise-complete witness.
The actual pseudoindex-five universal family implies 3S^2-20SD+32D^2=0 with D>0.
The minimal family is smooth and proper and has connected evaluation fibres and every-member splitting T_e restricted to C is O(-1)^3.
The rational cohomology of the projective-line fibration has the stated involution and integration product rule.
The shifted Chern classes r,s,t descend using the actual degree-one line bundle A.
The relative Hodge bundles for evaluation over the simply connected projective base are holomorphically trivial.
Positive-degree direct images of td(E) and td(E)ch(E dual) vanish.
All six row families of A annihilate the geometric weight-nine intersection vector.
The tangent-map polarization is ample and selected intersection coordinates factor as the normalized xi_i eta_j.
For the exact rational matrices defined in the manuscript, xi_0=eta_0=1 and N(xi_i eta_j)=0 imply 32-20eta_1+3eta_1^2=0.
Every smooth connected complex Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous.
The Picard-number-at-least-two sixfold case is covered by Kanemitsu Theorem 0.2.
Picard-number-one sixfolds outside projective space and the quadric reduce to pseudoindices four and five.
The pseudoindex-four sixfold case is homogeneous.
The numerical constraint, tangent-image geometry, and citation-faithful recognition hypotheses identify the pseudoindex-five sixfold with Gr(2,5).
The scoped mathematical certificate has passed Host-invoked independent Reviewer replay, with novelty and significance assessed separately.

The supplied finite calculation alone does not establish all-member splitting, shifted descent, Hodge-bundle triviality, or VMRT recognition; bounded no-witness searches and homogeneous examples cannot certify the full sixfold theorem.
The Picard-number-at-least-two sixfold case is covered by Kanemitsu Theorem 0.2.

routes.retired_because: Exact cubic row elimination was interrupted without a target identity after substantial coefficient and fill growth, including reduced and saturated bases. This implementation-level non-conclusion is superseded by the passing R67_RANK_CERT; it does not prove that direct cofactors cannot exist.

The bounded extended module normal-form computation had not produced explicit cofactors when it was stopped after R67_RANK_CERT passed. This is supersession without a mathematical verdict, not nonexistence of a polynomial identity.
